title: Guardrail HTTP adapter response v1
description: The body a guardrail http detector returns with status 200 (ADR-0043 decision 1). Mirrors AdapterResponse in services/elitea-llm-gateway/internal/guardrail/httpadapter.go. An empty findings list means no finding. start and end are offsets in Unicode code points of the request content, end exclusive; a finding with neither covers the whole content. A finding without a score counts as score 1. Any other status, a body over 1 MiB, more than 1000 findings, or a body that does not match this schema is a detector failure, and the row's fail mode applies.
